## Foundations

#### ★★★ The Art of Computer Programming, Vol. 1: Fundamental Algorithms (3rd ed.)

Donald Knuth · 1997 · *Addison-Wesley* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22The%20Art%20of%20Computer%20Programming%2C%20Vol.%201%3A%20Fundamental%20Algorithms%20%283rd%20ed.%29%22)

- **Why:** Boundary-tag coalescing, first fit vs best fit. Your block layout comes from here.

#### ★★☆ Dynamic storage allocation: A survey and critical review

Wilson, Johnstone, Neely & Boles · 1995 · *International Workshop on Memory Management* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Dynamic%20storage%20allocation%3A%20A%20survey%20and%20critical%20review%22)

- **Why:** The survey that corrected decades of folklore about fragmentation.
- **Read:** §1–3.

## Real allocators

#### ★★☆ Hoard: A scalable memory allocator for multithreaded applications

Berger, McKinley, Blumofe & Wilson · 2000 · *ASPLOS* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Hoard%3A%20A%20scalable%20memory%20allocator%20for%20multithreaded%20applications%22)

- **Why:** Hoard: per-processor heaps with provable bounds on blowup. The start of scalable `malloc`.
- **Read:** §1–4.

#### ★★☆ A scalable concurrent malloc(3) implementation for FreeBSD

Jason Evans · 2006 · *BSDCan* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22A%20scalable%20concurrent%20malloc%283%29%20implementation%20for%20FreeBSD%22)

- **Why:** jemalloc: arenas, size classes and thread caches.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★☆ Mimalloc: Free list sharding in action

Leijen, Zorn & de Moura · 2019 · *APLAS* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Mimalloc%3A%20Free%20list%20sharding%20in%20action%22)

- **Why:** mimalloc: free-list sharding per page. Simple, fast and elegant.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★★ Beyond malloc efficiency to fleet efficiency: a hugepage-aware memory allocator

Hunter et al. · 2021 · *OSDI* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Beyond%20malloc%20efficiency%20to%20fleet%20efficiency%3A%20a%20hugepage-aware%20memory%20allocator%22)
